violations.text: Observed the outside dumpster lids not closed at time of inspection. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered/closed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The floors in the (front) area underneath/behind equipment and shelving have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris and other debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2025
